name: Gilbert Rance
source:
Favorite Style: Diamond

A man who suddenly appears in front of you is Gilbert Rance, the Griffon.
He is a sincere and honest man, but he is on the wanted list in Wonderland because he has obtained freedom.

"Freedom is not allowed in Wonderland. That's why they call me a 'betrayal'."

[Official in-game description]
